reason: I have never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here tells me the fixtures are UL listed. I would save the pendant to a board and keep looking, not buy a hardwired light from a store I don't know.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? Nothing here says so, and I'm not putting an unknown fixture in a rental unit. A paper pendant for $360 from a store I don't know also makes me doubt the build quality, and I'd pay return shipping if it looks cheap in person.
would_change_my_mind: A visible UL or ETL listing on the product page, plus real customer photos and reviews, and free return shipping on a fixture that disappoints.
